climate.koppen_name: Cold, no dry season, hot summer

blurb.text: A Finger Lakes AVA around Seneca Lake, a glacial lake about 35 miles long and up to 600 feet deep. The lake does not freeze, so it stores heat and lengthens the growing season. Riesling is the most commercially important grape.
